item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence that Srettha directed or tolerated Thai-backed militias, proxy fighters, or arms recipients committing atrocities or destabilization. I also found no evidence of a specific case where he had to accept responsibility for foreseeable proxy conduct. The strongest available record is the opposite: coordinated border management, humanitarian delivery, ASEAN diplomacy, and repeated de-escalation.","evidence":[{"title":"ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Statement on the Escalation of Conflicts in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 18, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?menu=5d5bd3dc15e39c306002ab1c&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac","summary":"ASEAN, with Thailand as a member, called for immediate cessation of violence, utmost restraint, and protection of civilians along the Thailand-Myanmar border. This is strong evidence that Thailand was trying to restrain destabilizing conduct rather than enable it.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.4","2B.1"]},{"title":"Humanitarian assistance from Thailand to the people of Myanmar distributed at three pilot areas in Kayin State","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"March 27, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/humanitarianaidbyrc1?menu=5d5bd3dc15e39c306002ab1c&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac","summary":"Thailand supported a cross-border humanitarian delivery with the Thai Red Cross, Myanmar Red Cross, local communities, and AHA Centre technical oversight to ensure transparent aid. This is positive evidence of constraining border spillover and using civilian channels instead of proxy force.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.4","2B.1"]},{"title":"Special Envoy of ASEAN Chair on Myanmar welcomes successful pilot project of humanitarian initiative between Thailand and Myanmar during his meeting with Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs of Thailand","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"March 26, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm260324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand briefed the ASEAN envoy on expanding humanitarian assistance along the border, with Red Cross and AHA Centre participation. That suggests active restraint and responsibility for foreseeable cross-border effects rather than permissive proxy conduct.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.4","2B.1"]},{"title":"Vice Foreign Minister Sihasak meets with Special Envoy of ASEAN Chair on Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 24, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/pr210424-2","summary":"Thailand and the ASEAN envoy stressed de-escalation, cessation of hostilities in Myawaddy, and ASEAN centrality. This is evidence that the Thai government was trying to stop escalation at the border, not exploit armed factions for advantage.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.1","1B.8"]},{"title":"Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs and ICRC Representatives discuss humanitarian situation in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 26, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm-meets-with-icrc-reps-250424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand and the ICRC discussed humanitarian assistance to all groups in need in Myanmar without discrimination. That is consistent with restraint and civilian protection, not proxy-enabled atrocities.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.4"]},{"title":"Summary of Weekly Press Briefing 19 April 2024 at 11.00 hrs.","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 19, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/weeklypressbriefing190424-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand said it was monitoring the Myanmar situation closely, created a special committee, and was open to dialogue with stakeholders. That is a clear signal of controlled, government-led crisis management rather than outsourcing coercion to proxies.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.1","1B.8"]},{"title":"Deputy Foreign Minister and National Security delegation visit Mae Sot to receive the latest update on the Thailand-Myanmar border situation","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 23, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/dpmfm-dpmim-dm-nscsg-maesot-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"A high-level delegation from foreign affairs, defense, the armed forces, police, and NSC visited Mae Sot to coordinate support for local agencies. This is evidence of central oversight and containment, not permissive proxy or militia behavior.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.1","1B.8"]}]}
